title: Meta says Muse video chat is on for US users, on phone, web, and Mac
friendlyTitle: Meta says people in the US can now video-chat with its Muse agent
summary: TechCrunch reports that Muse Voice, the feature for calling and video-chatting Meta's consumer agent Muse, is now available to everyone in the United States. Meta announced the rollout on Thursday, in a research blog post and on X from chief AI officer Alexandr Wang. The avatar, nicknamed Jolly, can be changed to look more like a person, an animal, or another character. Meta says it uses small expressions and gestures that match the tone of the conversation. TechCrunch says the calls work on mobile, web, and Mac, and will later come to Meta's AI glasses and a planned Muse Charm device. The Charm, a small wearable Meta has said it wants out before year-end, is not this week's release.
